purpose: Test lunar pretrained representations and task/candidate-conditioned decisions using existing public benchmark labels; do not continue scaling the unsupported low-rank posterior hypothesis.

source_audit.note: Null means pending verification. Resolve commits, hashes, file sizes, task filtering and separate code/data licenses before use.

execution_order.work: Read-only asset/weight/license/disk/dependency audit and exact download allowlist
Loader, normalization, missing-mask, class-map and official-split tests; real pixel I/O where available
Age ordinary-head smoke and baseline; frozen feature feasibility before complex decision modules
Geology ordinary head versus candidate-conditioned head with identical visible inputs and encoder
Separately specified candidate-order/subset, modality-missing and calibration analyses

evaluation.official_default: Use stored official split IDs and task filtering; never recreate the 70/15/15 split to match rounded counts
evaluation.official_geographic_later: Verify upstream boundaries: train abs(lat)<=60, val 60<abs(lat)<=70, test 70<abs(lat)<=80
evaluation.not_an_ood_claim: Random benchmark splits are not geographic OOD; downstream geographic holdout is not proof of pretraining-unseen geography
evaluation.calibration: No test fitting. If val_select/val_cal is introduced, lock it before tuning and label it separately from official full-validation reproduction.
candidate_controls: same candidate lists for all methods
ordering stability is not unseen-class generalization
evaluation.test_execution: Only after input, model/configuration and analysis are fixed; no score-guided repeated selection

resource_limits.primary_device: existing RX 7900 XT and working ROCm environment
resource_limits.cap_origin: new sprint engineering guardrail; not a user-specified cloud budget
resource_limits.checkpoint_downloads: Count actual bytes; larger assets require a reviewed, disk-safe plan, not an automatic metadata exception
